GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)
New Delhi, the 25th July, 2026
The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from 25th July, 2026:
Shri Dharmendra Pradhan relinquished the charge of the office of the Minister of
Education.
Shri Pralhad Joshi assumed the charge of the office of the Minister of Education.
He will continue to hold the charge of the office of the Minister of Consumer
Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; and the charge of the office of the Minister
of New and Renewable Energy.
25/7/2026
(Anita Tripathi)
